    target_error=max(float(s['max_inner_target_B_error_code']),float(s['max_stage_inner_target_B_error_code']))
    relative_target=safe_ratio(target_error,scale)
    ct=float(s['integrated_CT_work_actual_ghost_trace_code']);native=float(s['integrated_boundary_energy_minus_hydro_code'])
    signed_work=safe_ratio(native-ct,ct)
    stages=int(s['stage_calls']);steps=int(s['steps']);blocks=int(s.get('radial_meshblocks',1))
    g={
      'native_face_incidence':gate(fields['maximum_cell_flux_residual_over_unsigned_face_flux'],thresholds['native_face_flux_incidence_relative']),
      'inner_stage_and_endpoint_target_relative_error':gate(relative_target,thresholds['inner_stage_and_endpoint_target_relative_error'],note='Normalized by maximum recorded native Br scale; zero/zero is zero, nonzero/zero is undefined'),

      'floor_activations':gate(int(s['floor_activations']),thresholds['floor_activations']),
      'strict_pre_floor_abort':{'value':s.get('strict_floor_abort'),'passed':s.get('strict_floor_abort') is True},
      'mass_energy_budget':gate(max(float(s['max_mass_budget_relative_error']),float(s['max_energy_budget_relative_error'])),thresholds['maximum_passive_mass_energy_budget_relative_error']),
      'actual_trace_local_boundary_work':gate(float(s['max_actual_trace_work_discrepancy_over_total_energy_flux']),thresholds['local_boundary_work_mismatch_over_total_energy_flux_target']),

      'all_volume_fields_finite':{'value':fields['all_volume_fields_finite'],'passed':fields['all_volume_fields_finite']},
      'all_volume_density_pressure_positive':{'value':fields['all_volume_density_pressure_positive'],'passed':fields['all_volume_density_pressure_positive']},

def load_curve(folder):
    a=postprocess.own_case(folder.name,folder=folder)
    if len(a['day'])<2 or not np.all(np.diff(a['day'])>0):raise ValueError('Comet probe0 must contain at least two strictly increasing epochs')
    for key in a:
        if not np.all(np.isfinite(a[key])):raise ValueError('Nonfinite comet curve: '+key)
    ep=postprocess.tsv(ROOT/'observations/ephemeris_comet.tsv')
    if a['day'][0]<ep['mjd_utc'][0]-postprocess.ORIGIN-1e-10 or a['day'][-1]>ep['mjd_utc'][-1]-postprocess.ORIGIN+1e-10:raise ValueError('Comet velocity would extrapolate its ephemeris')
    return observer_case(a,{'time_convention':'observer_arrival'})

def coverage(a,spans):return bool(all(start>=a['day'][0]-1e-8 and stop<=a['day'][-1]+1e-8 for start,stop in spans))
def extrema(a,spans):
    if not coverage(a,spans):raise ValueError('Refusing temporal extrapolation in extrema')
    t=np.unique(np.concatenate([np.r_[s,a['day'][(a['day']>s)&(a['day']<e)],e] for s,e in spans]))
    result={}
    for k in OBS_FIELDS:
        z=np.interp(t,a['day'],a[k]);lo=int(np.argmin(z));hi=int(np.argmax(z))
        result[k]={'min':float(z[lo]),'max':float(z[hi]),'minimum_arrival_day':float(t[lo]),'maximum_arrival_day':float(t[hi])}

3I/ATLAS solar-wind reconstruction — Codex

STATUS: completed 3D constrained-transport (CT) control runs pass the current
formulation and long-run parallel-equivalence checks. Full numerical
convergence, domain/initial-condition qualification and an explicit final CT
reference selection are still pending. These passes do not establish accuracy.
The current report.html remains provisional until selected CT products are
rendered. The earlier GLM report and its directly linked records are preserved
at report_glm_history.html and history/glm/archive_manifest.json.

The CT calculation uses pinned Athena++ native double-precision HLLD transport,
PLM reconstruction, SSPRK2, spherical geometry, gravity and staggered magnetic
CT. Our problem generator supplies the calibrated, rotating boundary, compatible
surface electric fields, physical ghost cells, probes and passive audits. Native
radial MeshBlocks/OpenMP provide CPU parallelism; CT does not use the GPU.
The pinned upstream is https://github.com/PrincetonUniversity/athena at commit
e47fabb7dd5efb22e1e2c7ff193148d723e3e952. Sources, own code, compiled binaries,
receipts and tests are retained under solver/athena_ct*, solver/athena_ct_pins/ and validation/.

Work from this directory with Python 3.12 and requirements.txt installed. GCC
with OpenMP and GNU time are needed for solver builds/run accounting; ffmpeg
is needed for MP4/GIF product rendering. Frozen archived CT executables allow
replay without a new Athena checkout, /tmp build tree or network access.
Acquisition from NASA, NSO, JPL and the other cited services is documented
separately; reproduction uses the copied inputs and evidence already present.

Reproduction:

    make plan

This prints a read-only plan from results/reference_selection.json and the
selected cases' actual run.cfg, native input, code selection, input/source
hashes and runner receipts. It invents no reference, case, settings or resource
caps. It refuses a missing CT selection, missing records, changed hashes, or
configuration disagreement. required_case_names, when explicitly present in
the selection, defines the campaign; otherwise the union of the selected
reference/animation and all category_comparisons supplies its case names.

    make simulations

This explicitly executes the planned groups through the qualified archived-pin
controller. Matching completed cases are reused. To recompute the recorded
campaign, explicitly use:

    make simulations FORCE=--force
